f3_program: collection("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts", "daily_bird_count", "bird_watcher", source("records the number of birds he sees each day"))
member("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts", "bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts.monday", source("One Monday he sees 70 birds"))
member("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts", "bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts.tuesday", source("On Tuesday he sees half as many birds as he did on Monday"))
member("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts", "bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts.wednesday", source("On Wednesday he sees 8 more birds than he did on Tuesday"))
observe(at("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts.monday", "monday"), 70, "count", source("One Monday he sees 70 birds"))
fraction_of(at("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts.tuesday", "tuesday"), at("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts.monday", "monday"), 1, 2, source("On Tuesday he sees half as many birds as he did on Monday"))

offset(at("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts.wednesday", "wednesday"), at("bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts.tuesday", "tuesday"), 8, "count", source("On Wednesday he sees 8 more birds than he did on Tuesday"))
query("sum", "bird_watcher.daily_bird_counts", "monday_to_wednesday")
add("purchase_cucumbers", "isabela", at("isabela.cucumbers.count", "current"), 100, source("bought 100 cucumbers"))
add("purchase_pencils", "isabela", at("isabela.pencils.count", "current"), "isabela.pencils.purchased.count", source("bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils"))
multiple(event_field("purchase_cucumbers", "quantity"), event_field("purchase_pencils", "quantity"), 2, source("bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils"))
observe(at("isabela.cucumbers.listed_unit_price", "purchase"), 20, "currency_per_item", source("both costing $20 each"))
observe(at("isabela.pencils.listed_unit_price", "purchase"), 20, "currency_per_item", source("both costing $20 each"))
percent_less(at("isabela.pencils.discounted_unit_price", "purchase"), at("isabela.pencils.listed_unit_price", "purchase"), 20, source("a 20% discount on the pencils"))
query("value", "isabela.purchase.total_amount_spent")
assumptions: The stated pencil discount applies to the listed per-pencil price.

f3_program: observe(at("tristan.study.duration", "monday"), 4, "hour", source("On Monday, he studies for 4 hours"))
multiple(at("tristan.study.duration", "tuesday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "monday"), 2, source("studies for twice this long on Tuesday"))
observe(at("tristan.study.duration", "wednesday"), 3, "hour", source("On Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday he studies for 3 hours each day"))
observe(at("tristan.study.duration", "thursday"), 3, "hour", source("On Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday he studies for 3 hours each day"))
observe(at("tristan.study.duration", "friday"), 3, "hour", source("On Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday he studies for 3 hours each day"))
observe(at("tristan.study.planned_total_duration", "week"), 25, "hour", source("a total of 25 hours over the week"))

sum_relation(at("tristan.study.planned_total_duration", "week"), at("tristan.study.duration", "monday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "tuesday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "wednesday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "thursday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "friday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "saturday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "sunday"), source("a total of 25 hours over the week"))
same(at("tristan.study.duration", "saturday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "sunday"), source("divides the remaining amount of study time evenly between Saturday and Sunday"))
query("value", at("tristan.study.duration", "saturday"))
assumptions: Dividing the remaining study time evenly means Saturday and Sunday have equal study durations.

f3_program: collection("sit_up_sessions.completed_counts", "sit_up_count", "barney_carrie_jerrie", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute, and Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes, and Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
observe(at("barney.sit_up.rate", "current"), 45, "sit_up_per_minute", source("Barney can perform 45 sit-ups in one minute"))
multiple(at("carrie.sit_up.rate", "current"), at("barney.sit_up.rate", "current"), 2, source("Carrie can do twice as many sit-ups per minute as Barney can"))
offset(at("jerrie.sit_up.rate", "current"), at("carrie.sit_up.rate", "current"), 5, "sit_up_per_minute", source("Jerrie can do 5 more sit-ups per minute than Carrie can do"))
observe(at("barney.sit_up_session.duration", "current"), 1, "minute", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
observe(at("carrie.sit_up_session.duration", "current"), 2, "minute", source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
observe(at("jerrie.sit_up_session.duration", "current"), 3, "minute", source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
produce("barney_session", "barney", at("barney.sit_ups.completed.count", "current"), "sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.barney", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
produce("carrie_session", "carrie", at("carrie.sit_ups.completed.count", "current"), "sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.carrie", source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
produce("jerrie_session", "jerrie", at("jerrie.sit_ups.completed.count", "current"), "sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.jerrie", source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
rate_relation("sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.barney", at("barney.sit_up.rate", "current"), at("barney.sit_up_session.duration", "current"), source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
rate_relation("sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.carrie", at("carrie.sit_up.rate", "current"), at("carrie.sit_up_session.duration", "current"), source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
rate_relation("sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.jerrie", at("jerrie.sit_up.rate", "current"), at("jerrie.sit_up_session.duration", "current"), source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
member("sit_up_sessions.completed_counts", "sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.barney", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
member("sit_up_sessions.completed_counts", "sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.carrie", source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
member("sit_up_sessions.completed_counts", "sit_up_sessions.completed_counts.jerrie", source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
query("sum", "sit_up_sessions.completed_counts", "current")
assumptions: The stated per-minute abilities are the rates used during the described sit-up sessions.

f3_program: observe(at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "initial"), 330, "count", source("Dr. Banks had 330 toothbrushes"))
remove("january_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), 53, source("He gave away 53 toothbrushes in January"))
remove("february_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), 67, source("He gave away 67 toothbrushes in February"))
remove("march_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), 46, source("In March he gave away 46 toothbrushes"))

remove("april_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), fraction(at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "after_march"), 1, 2), source("In April and May, he gave away the remaining toothbrushes, half each month"))

remove("may_giveaway", "dr_banks", at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "current"), fraction(at("dr_banks.toothbrushes.count", "after_march"), 1, 2), source("In April and May, he gave away the remaining toothbrushes, half each month"))
query("difference", "dr_banks.monthly_toothbrush_giveaways.slowest.quantity", "dr_banks.monthly_toothbrush_giveaways.busiest.quantity")
assumptions: Each of April and May receives one half of the common quantity remaining after March.
The busiest and slowest months are selected from January through May.
